label: Thermal stress score (vs control bed)
description: leaf minus control-bed leaf temperature, as a z-score against the plant's own 30 Aug–2 Sep values at the same time of day

label: Thermal stress score (no control bed)
description: leaf minus air temperature above a line in VPD fitted on all plants in the baseline window (30 Aug–2 Sep), as a z-score against the plant's own baseline

label: Leaf − air above the published sugar beet line
description: leaf minus air temperature minus Idso's (1982) non-water-stressed sugar beet line, 2.50 − 1.92 × VPD (kPa)

label: Leaf − control bed, 15 h − 09 h
description: afternoon (15 h) minus morning (09 h) run of the same day, of thermal_leaf_ref_dt

label: Leaf − control bed, daily range
description: highest minus lowest run of the day (at least 4 runs), of thermal_leaf_ref_dt

label: Leaf − control bed, overnight
description: next morning's 06 h minus this evening's 18 h run, of thermal_leaf_ref_dt

label: Leaf − air, 15 h − 09 h
description: afternoon (15 h) minus morning (09 h) run of the same day, of thermal_leaf_air_dt

label: Leaf − air, daily range
description: highest minus lowest run of the day (at least 4 runs), of thermal_leaf_air_dt

label: Leaf − air, overnight
description: next morning's 06 h minus this evening's 18 h run, of thermal_leaf_air_dt
